    Requirements

    Unity

    • Unity 6000.0 or newer
    • The Android Build Support module

    The window finds and pairs devices with the adb in Unity's Android module. Without the module, the window only shows a notice that it can't be used. Add Android Build Support to your editor version in Unity Hub.

    This is an editor-only package and adds no runtime code to your builds.

    Device and network

    • A device running Android 11 or newer
    • Your computer and the device must be on the same Wi-Fi network.

    Android SDK Platform-Tools

    What the window shows depends on the Platform-Tools version in Unity's Android SDK.

    Platform-Tools Available
    Below 36 Device list, pairing, connecting (no device name, API, or ADB Wi-Fi version)
    36 or newer Device name, API, and ADB Wi-Fi version
    37 or newer ADB Wi-Fi 2.0 (Android 17+ devices)

    If Platform-Tools is below 37, you can update it from the window. See Settings > Update Platform-Tools.
